patterns.what_worked: Lazy widget creation behind the new nil-off toggles kept bars_state's SHAMAN construction counts untouched (no reconcile debt for this class), and the mutation proofs immediately exposed two weak checks (an FS-guard-masked rune-gate assertion and a stale-text pin that post_init had silently reset) - both were tightened and re-proven.
patterns.what_was_hard: S4's FS-collision guard can only act through the gather (the engine is frozen): the gather now narrows mw_available while FS < 2 s and the shock is ready, so the frozen rules fall through to the Flame Shock refresh. The guide slot's post_init LvB re-point keeps its client-data gate because its sibling suite (tests/shaman_guide_state.lua) is out of scope this round and pins that shape - the player-level rune gate lands on the assist's MW5 marker instead. Recorded, not hidden.
patterns.skill_gap: Offline harness cannot load the addon: the guard's exact in-game feel, the option visuals and the new bar/wash layout need the owner's in-client pass.
